summary: Bail under PMLA; Section 45 mandatory conditions; prima facie case of money laundering involving Rs.17+ crore; proceeds concealed via hawala, property purchases, construction; High Court error in granting bail without satisfying Section 45(1)(b); statements under Section 50 not sole basis; cooperation and tax payment noted but insufficient; bail grant challenged; PMLA's overriding effect on Cr.P.C.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court bail order set aside; respondent not entitled to bail under Section 45 of PMLA; custody restored.
